---
title: "Recorded Vegetation Biomass: Preliminary ANOVA"
output:
  bookdown::pdf_document2:
    keep_tex: true
    toc: false
    number_sections: false
    extra_dependencies: ["float"]
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  cache = FALSE,
  fig.pos = "H",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 4.5
)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# ============================================================
# Confirmed analysis settings
# ============================================================

quadrat_areas <- c(
  Broccoli = 0.28,
  Cover_crop = 0.16
)

treatment_order <- c("T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T4 = "Pre-transplant\nonly (T4)",
  T3 = "Every 2 months\n(T3)",
  T2 = "Monthly\n(T2)"
)

location_labels <- c(
  Broccoli = "Broccoli row",
  Cover_crop = "Cover crop area"
)

# All recorded plant species are included.
# Exact duplicate rows are removed, keeping the first occurrence.
# Unrecorded quadrats are not assigned zero biomass.
# Sampling and data collection are still incomplete.

# ============================================================
# Download the workbook from GitHub
# ============================================================

github_base <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "Pr1nc3sso/Xilei-Living-cover-crop/",
  "master/2-Data/Raw/Raw/"
)

file_url <- paste0(
  github_base,
  URLencode(
    "Vegetation survey - broccoli harvest.xlsx",
    reserved = TRUE
  )
)

file_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")

options(timeout = max(120, getOption("timeout", 60)))

download_status <- download.file(
  url = file_url,
  destfile = file_path,
  method = "libcurl",
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)

if (download_status != 0L ||
    !file.exists(file_path) ||
    file.info(file_path)$size == 0) {
  stop("Download failed. Check the GitHub URL and connection.")
}

output_dir <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  "Biomass_ANOVA_results"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Read the original records
# ============================================================

raw <- read_excel(
  path = file_path,
  sheet = "2026",
  range = cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = "text"
)

if (ncol(raw) != 10L) {
  stop("Expected ten columns in worksheet 2026.")
}

names(raw) <- c(
  "collection_date",
  "weeks_after_transplanting",
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "quadrat",
  "location",
  "species",
  "weight_g",
  "source_area_m2",
  "weight_date"
)

raw$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(raw)) + 1L

raw <- raw %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      -excel_row,
      ~ !is.na(.x) & trimws(.x) != ""
    )
  )

n_original_records <- nrow(raw)

# Compare all ten original columns.
# Excel row numbers are excluded from duplicate detection.
duplicate_flag <- duplicated(
  raw %>% select(-excel_row)
)

removed_duplicates <- raw[duplicate_flag, , drop = FALSE]

dat <- raw[!duplicate_flag, , drop = FALSE]

n_removed_duplicates <- nrow(removed_duplicates)

write.csv(
  removed_duplicates,
  file.path(output_dir, "Removed_exact_duplicates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Standardize and validate the records
# ============================================================

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(block, treatment, quadrat, weight_g, source_area_m2),
      as.numeric
    ),
    location = gsub(
      "[[:space:]]+",
      "_",
      trimws(location)
    ),
    species = toupper(trimws(species))
  )

required_columns <- c(
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "quadrat",
  "location",
  "species",
  "weight_g"
)

if (anyNA(dat[required_columns])) {
  stop("Missing or invalid identifiers, species, or weights.")
}

if (any(!is.finite(dat$weight_g)) ||
    any(dat$weight_g < 0)) {
  stop("Biomass weights must be finite and non-negative.")
}

if (any(!dat$block %in% 1:4) ||
    any(!dat$treatment %in% 1:4) ||
    any(!dat$quadrat %in% 1:4) ||
    any(!dat$location %in% c("Broccoli", "Cover_crop"))) {
  stop("Unexpected block, treatment, quadrat, or location.")
}

# Compare the three mowing treatments.
dat <- dat %>%
  filter(treatment %in% 2:4) %>%
  mutate(
    block = paste0("B", block),
    treatment = paste0("T", treatment),
    area_m2 = unname(quadrat_areas[location])
  )

if (nrow(dat) == 0L) {
  stop("No records were found for T2, T3, and T4.")
}

if (anyNA(dat$area_m2) || any(dat$area_m2 <= 0)) {
  stop("A valid confirmed area is required for every quadrat.")
}

# Original area values are preserved in source_area_m2.
# Analysis uses the confirmed area_m2 values.

# ============================================================
# Sum all recorded species within each quadrat
# ============================================================

quadrat_data <- dat %>%
  group_by(
    block,
    treatment,
    location,
    quadrat
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    recorded_biomass_g = sum(weight_g),
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    n_records = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    biomass_g_m2 = recorded_biomass_g / area_m2
  )

# ============================================================
# Identify quadrats without records
# ============================================================

expected_quadrats <- expand_grid(
  block = paste0("B", 1:4),
  treatment = paste0("T", 2:4),
  location = c("Broccoli", "Cover_crop"),
  quadrat = 1:2
)

quadrat_keys <- c(
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "location",
  "quadrat"
)

missing_quadrats <- anti_join(
  expected_quadrats,
  quadrat_data,
  by = quadrat_keys
)

unexpected_quadrats <- anti_join(
  quadrat_data,
  expected_quadrats,
  by = quadrat_keys
)

if (nrow(unexpected_quadrats) > 0L) {
  stop("Unexpected quadrat IDs were found for T2, T3, or T4.")
}

# ============================================================
# Calculate one response per experimental plot and location
# ============================================================

# Average only the quadrats currently represented in the data.
# Do not divide by two when only one quadrat has records.
# Do not treat individual species or bags as independent plots.

plot_data <- quadrat_data %>%
  group_by(
    block,
    treatment,
    location
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    biomass_g_m2 = mean(biomass_g_m2),
    n_quadrats = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(
      block,
      levels = paste0("B", 1:4)
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = treatment_order
    )
  )

sampling_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(location, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plots = n(),
    n_quadrats = sum(n_quadrats),
    mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(biomass_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# Save the data used in the analysis
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  dat,
  file.path(output_dir, "Analysis_records.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  quadrat_data,
  file.path(output_dir, "Quadrat_biomass.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  plot_data,
  file.path(output_dir, "Plot_biomass.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  missing_quadrats,
  file.path(output_dir, "Quadrats_without_records.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

show_table <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  cat("\n\n")

  if (nrow(x) > 0L) {
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        x,
        digits = digits,
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  } else {
    cat("None.\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Analysis scope

This is a preliminary analysis of the biomass recorded so far.
Sampling and data collection are incomplete.

All recorded plant species are included, including clovers and
unidentified plants. The response is therefore recorded vegetation
biomass, not weed-only biomass.

The analysis compares T2, T3, and T4. T1 is not included in this
mowing-frequency comparison.

Broccoli-row quadrats have an area of 0.28 square metres.
Cover-crop quadrats have an area of 0.16 square metres.

Broccoli-row vegetation was cut at ground level.
Cover-crop vegetation was cut at 8 cm above ground.
The two sampling locations are analysed separately.

The workbook is treated as one harvest-period vegetation survey.
Missing collection dates are not used to create additional sampling rounds.

## Duplicate removal and sampling coverage

Original records: `r n_original_records`.

Exact duplicate records removed: `r n_removed_duplicates`.

Records included in the T2-T4 analysis: `r nrow(dat)`.

Duplicate detection uses all ten original data columns.
Only the first occurrence of each exact duplicate is retained.

Different recorded weights within the same quadrat and species are
retained and summed.

```{r sampling-coverage, results='asis'}
show_table(sampling_summary)
```

## Quadrats without records

The following expected quadrats currently have no records.
They are not assigned zero biomass.

Plot means use the available quadrats only. Unequal numbers of quadrats,
and incomplete recording within quadrats, can affect treatment comparisons.

```{r missing-quadrats, results='asis'}
show_table(missing_quadrats)
```

## Preliminary ANOVA and treatment comparisons

Species weights are summed within each quadrat, divided by the confirmed
quadrat area, and averaged within each plot and sampling location.

Each block-by-treatment plot is one experimental replicate.
Quadrats and species records are subsamples.

The model is:

`biomass_g_m2 ~ treatment + block`

Treatment and block are fitted as fixed factors.
The model assumes additive treatment and block effects.

Adjusted means have individual 95% confidence intervals.
Tukey adjustment is applied to the three pairwise treatment comparisons
within each sampling location.

These tests are exploratory because sampling and recording are incomplete.
They should not be treated as final evidence of treatment effects.

```{r biomass-analysis, results='asis'}
for (loc in c("Broccoli", "Cover_crop")) {

  cat(
    "\n\n### ",
    location_labels[[loc]],
    "\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  current_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(location == loc)

  # The current dataset contains one response for each of 12 plots.
  # Stop if an entire plot is absent rather than inventing zero biomass.
  if (nrow(current_data) != 12L ||
      any(table(
        current_data$block,
        current_data$treatment
      ) != 1L)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Expected all 12 plots for location:",
        loc,
        "An entirely unrecorded plot must not be treated as zero."
      )
    )
  }

  # Fit the randomized complete block model.
  fit <- lm(
    biomass_g_m2 ~ treatment + block,
    data = current_data
  )

  # ANOVA is valid as the balanced plot-level model specified above,
  # conditional on model assumptions and the preliminary data.
  anova_table <- as.data.frame(
    anova(fit)
  )

  anova_table$Term <- rownames(anova_table)
  rownames(anova_table) <- NULL

  anova_table <- anova_table %>%
    select(Term, everything())

  # Adjusted treatment means.
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit,
    ~ treatment,
    weights = "equal"
  )

  mean_table <- as.data.frame(
    confint(
      emm,
      level = 0.95
    )
  )

  # Tukey-adjusted treatment comparisons.
  tukey_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      pairs(
        emm,
        adjust = "tukey"
      ),
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  cat("\n\nPlot-level recorded biomass:\n\n")

  show_table(
    current_data %>%
      select(
        block,
        treatment,
        n_quadrats,
        biomass_g_m2
      )
  )

  cat("\n\nPreliminary ANOVA:\n\n")
  show_table(anova_table, digits = 5)

  cat("\n\nAdjusted treatment means and 95% confidence intervals:\n\n")
  show_table(mean_table, digits = 3)

  cat("\n\nTukey pairwise comparisons:\n\n")
  show_table(tukey_table, digits = 4)

  # Extract the treatment test for the figure subtitle.
  treatment_test <- anova_table %>%
    filter(Term == "treatment")

  f_value <- treatment_test[["F value"]]
  p_value <- treatment_test[["Pr(>F)"]]

  model_subtitle <- sprintf(
    "Preliminary ANOVA: F(2, %d) = %.2f; p = %.4f",
    df.residual(fit),
    f_value,
    p_value
  )

  # Plot original plot-level observations and model estimates.
  p <- ggplot(
    current_data,
    aes(
      x = treatment,
      y = biomass_g_m2
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = block),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.08,
        height = 0,
        seed = 1
      ),
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = mean_table,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        ymin = lower.CL,
        ymax = upper.CL
      ),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = mean_table,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        y = emmean
      ),
      shape = 18,
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = treatment_labels
    ) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(
      title = location_labels[[loc]],
      subtitle = model_subtitle,
      x = "Cover crop mowing regime",
      y = "Recorded vegetation biomass (g/m2)",
      shape = "Block",
      caption = paste0(
        "Sampling incomplete; all recorded plant species included.\n",
        "Small points = plots; diamonds = adjusted means; ",
        "bars = 95% CI."
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0,
        size = 8
      )
    )

  print(p)

  # Residual diagnostics.
  cat("\n\nModel diagnostics:\n\n")

  old_par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

  plot(fit, which = 1)
  plot(fit, which = 2)

  par(old_par)

  shapiro_p <- if (sd(residuals(fit)) > 0) {
    shapiro.test(residuals(fit))$p.value
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  cat(
    "\n\nResidual Shapiro-Wilk p = ",
    signif(shapiro_p, 4),
    ".\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat(
    "Inspect the residual plots as well as the test result. ",
    "A non-significant test does not prove normality. ",
    "No transformation is selected automatically.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  # Save results.
  write.csv(
    anova_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_ANOVA.csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    mean_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_Adjusted_means.csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    tukey_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_Tukey_comparisons.csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(
    fit,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_Model.rds")
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_Biomass_ANOVA.png")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 7,
    height = 4.5,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(loc, "_Biomass_ANOVA.pdf")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 7,
    height = 4.5,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```
